name: plugpup-citation
description: Create accurate APA 7, MLA 9 and Chicago citations from a DOI, ISBN, web page URL or article/book title. PlugPup looks up the real bibliographic record (Crossref, Open Library, the page's own metadata) instead of guessing, so authors, dates and details come from the real record. Switch styles in one tap and copy the result. Warns you when a source is missing an author or date.
